provenance_semantics: manifest.json records the bytes of every campaign artifact as of execution and is never rewritten. This supplement records the artifacts whose current bytes differ, with the reason for each. An artifact absent from this list must still match the executed manifest exactly. Protected artifacts - the frozen records and every experimental input, output, or recorded result - may never appear here; tools/campaign_current_state.py rejects such an entry.
supersedes: The removed W6_MUTABLE_SUPPORT_PATHS allowlist, which permitted ten documentation paths to drift unchecked once W6 completed, recording neither a reason nor the executed/current digest pair.
nonclaims: does not change any recorded result or boundary
does not upgrade any assurance dimension
declared drift is documentation/tooling only, never experimental evidence
